lin-chen.bio: Lin has been testing AI tools hands-on for 5+ years. Before AI Tool Hub, she was a senior product manager at a B2B SaaS company and a freelance technical writer. She has personally tested every tool in our directory. Lin writes the long-form reviews and the editor verdicts.
lin-chen.bio_full: Lin Chen is the Lead Reviewer and Editor-in-Chief at AI Tool Hub. She has spent over 5 years evaluating AI tools hands-on, testing more than 200 products across writing, coding, design, marketing, and research categories. Before founding AI Tool Hub, Lin was a senior product manager at a B2B SaaS company where she led the evaluation and procurement of AI tools for a 200-person team. She also spent 3 years as a freelance technical writer for enterprise software publications. Lin's reviews are known for being practical, data-driven, and always signed by name. She leads the editorial process, writes the final verdicts for all reviews, and personally tests every writing and content tool in the directory.
lin-chen.education: BA, English, UC Berkeley. MBA, Stanford GSB.
lin-chen.methodology: All reviews follow the AI Tool Hub structured evaluation criteria across 5 dimensions: output quality, ease of use, pricing transparency, support quality, and privacy. Every tool is tested hands-on for a minimum of 2 weeks on real work before a review is published.
